title: Member Chat acceptance rejects a successful persisted-conversation follow-up
surface: Hosted native Member A Chat acceptance harness
organization_context: Signed-in member with the selected organization bound to both requests
preconditions: Run the frozen v0.2.537 Member A acceptance against the exact published artifact.
Send an opening question and a follow-up in the same conversation.
reproduction: Inspect hosted acceptance run 39106477151, artifact 12127973860, and its reviewer-chat-store native report.
The opening POST to the agent/mandate route and the follow-up POST to /ai/conversations/{id} each return HTTP 200 and reach semantic terminal success with visible assistant answers.
Observe member_same_conversation_followup_route_unverified: the member oracle rejects the valid conversation route; the authenticated transport observer records only the first start.
expected: The harness accepts exactly one authenticated initial start and one authenticated persisted-conversation follow-up, both for the selected organization and same conversation, only after terminal semantic success and a new grounded assistant answer for each turn.
actual: The package observer captured two successful same-conversation turns, but the member oracle accepted only agent/mandate routes and the authenticated transport observer counted only starts. The harness stopped before its result screenshots and could not adjudicate Member A.
reproducibility: Captured native metadata deterministically distinguishes the opening canonical route from the valid persisted-conversation follow-up route; focused harness tests reproduce the original false negative.
severity: S2: Member A acceptance blocked by test infrastructure; no product failure established.
priority: P1: rerun the corrected native acceptance before assigning Member A credit.
cause: Two harness observers used an initial-start-only request model, while the extension's normal same-conversation follow-up uses POST /ai/conversations/{id}.
sibling_census: The package turn observer already recognizes persisted follow-ups. The member semantic oracle, authenticated transport observer, and organization-boundary test fixture were aligned to one start plus one same-conversation follow-up.
reviewer: Fresh independent peer review passed correctness and test adequacy after ordered-turn and sibling-fixture repairs.
acceptance_criteria: Opening start and persisted follow-up are both HTTP 200, terminally and semantically successful, with no pending tools or stream error.
Both requests carry the selected organization and the same conversation; duplicate, reordered, unrelated, pending, or failed requests refuse.
A guarded native rerun has valid browser, guest, and package resource finals before Member A receives product credit.

verification.focused: 36/36 combined browser oracle tests pass; pnpm compile and focused Biome pass.
verification.peer: Independent final correctness and test-adequacy reviews PASS.
verification.native: Pending guarded native rerun. Original run 39106477151 has guest resource CPU_PENDING/exit 3, so it carries zero product credit. The early harness assertion preceded the next 16-second resource watch; no resource threshold was changed.

limitations: The original native run is resource-invalid despite two diagnostic HTTP 200 terminal replies.
No Member A product or Store acceptance is claimed from this harness repair.
next_action: Release owner reruns Member A against the exact frozen v0.2.537 artifact through the guarded hosted path and reviews native answers and all resource finals.

transition_history.reason: Native run exposed a valid persisted-conversation follow-up rejected by the harness; resource final invalidated product credit.
